Egalitalias leading virologists have confirmed the emergence of a new, highly aggressive variant of the Llyndorran-origin virus, now designated Strain V-21. This mutation, first detected in the capital, is far deadlier and significantly more contagious than the original outbreak.

In the last 72 hours, infections have surged to 21,004 confirmed cases, with 1,732 fatalities recorded nationwide. Hospitals across the country are at maximum capacity, with temporary field hospitals being established in stadiums, convention centers, and military facilities to handle the overwhelming influx of patients.

Strain V-21 exhibits a shortened incubation period of less than 24 hours, more severe respiratory collapse, and a drastically higher fatality rate. Medical personnel are reporting cases of multi-organ failure within days of symptom onset. The virus spreads not only through droplets but also lingers longer in the air, making casual contact far more dangerous.

Effective immediately:

Total domestic travel lockdown, all non-essential movement between provinces is prohibited. Checkpoints and roadblocks will be enforced by the Armed Civil Guard.

Full PPE compliance remains mandatory. New directives require double masking or respirators in public spaces. PPE distribution centers are being expanded; armed escorts will accompany all shipments.

Curfew hours extended from 06:00 pm to 06:00 am. Violation of curfew will result in immediate detention and quarantine.

Public gatherings of any size are banned. Religious services, cultural events, and political rallies are suspended until further notice.

Workforce restrictions tightened, only sectors critical to survival (healthcare, food production, utilities) may operate in person. All others will transition to remote operations or suspend activities.

Hospitals will implement wartime triage protocols due to limited ICU capacity.

The National Security Council warns that the situation is critical and will worsen unless absolute compliance with public health orders is achieved. International intelligence cooperation is being sought to determine whether this mutation arose naturally or was deliberately engineered.

Egalitalia will not succumb to fear, we will contain Strain V-21, whatever its origin. All citizens are urged to remain indoors, protect themselves, and trust only official government communications.
